description: Located in the heart of Panaji, this beautiful religious destination is a key highlight of Goa tourism. Known as a legendary shrine in the region, it features peaceful prayer halls, spiritual meditation gardens, detailed wall murals, and gorgeous traditional architecture and attracts visitors from all over the world. Visitors can enjoy holy prasadam and authentic local vegetarian sweets at local vendors and capture beautiful memories here. Highly recommended for a solo trip.
